headline: 'Focused on the Finals': WNBA players tune out anthem talk from Trump, others
description: Players in the WNBA Finals said they are concentrating on preparing for the upcoming game and not President Donald Trump's criticism of them and others in the league for leaving the court prior to the national anthem being played.

headline: Fever fire GM, president steps down: What's next for Clark and Indiana?
description: Indiana's president stepped down and the Fever GM was fired Friday. What's next for a team with title aspirations?

headline: Fever fire GM Amber Cox; Stephanie White expected to remain coach, sources say
description: The Fever fired general manager Amber Cox on Friday, hours after the team announced that president Kelly Krauskopf stepped down. As of now, the expectation is that Stephanie White will remain Indiana's coach, sources told ESPN's Alexa Philippou.

headline: Valkyries seek 'fire' as crucial Game 4 looms in WNBA Finals
description: After losing their last two games by a combined 40 points, the Valkyries vowed to "show more fight" heading into Game 4 of the WNBA Finals against the Dream.

headline: Dream's Allisha Gray (hand) 'feeling fine, but I am not 100%'
description: Atlanta Dream guard Allisha Gray says she is "feeling fine, but I am not 100%" as she continues to deal with a left hand injury amid the WNBA Finals.

headline: Fever president Kelly Krauskopf steps down after 2nd stint
description: Fever president Kelly Krauskopf, who oversaw the team as it made the playoffs for 12 consecutive seasons, has stepped down from her position.
